proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, the establishment Sufi Zayn al-Din Khwafi labelled Ibn Turka and his circle naw-mulhidan (neo-batinis, even neo-Ismaʿilis).

mediation.note: A hostile contemporary label as reported by a modern historian; date and occasion not given on this page.
